findings.label: Hardcoded hex colors in kpi_calibration()
findings.description: #f87171, #fbbf24, and #4ade80 are hardcoded in app.py lines 153-161. In light mode these do not match the LIGHT palette tokens (danger=#cf222e, warning=#9a6700, success=#1a7f37). Fix: add theme parameter, call get_palette(theme), replace literals with p["danger"], p["warning"], p["success"].

findings.label: Duplicate badge() definition shadows delegating wrapper
findings.description: app.py defines badge() twice — line 106 (delegates to ui.components) and line 177 (raw inline). Python's namespace keeps only the second. All badge() calls after line 177 bypass ui.components. Remove the second definition.

findings.label: config.toml missing Inter font and palette color tokens
findings.description: font = "sans serif" does not load Inter. Absence of primaryColor/backgroundColor/secondaryBackgroundColor/textColor means Streamlit-native chrome flashes default styling on the first render frame before inject_css fires. Populate [theme] color tokens and remove or update the font key.
